charts.title: Global dairy and meat prices
charts.description: FAO monthly commodity price indices, August 2025 to July 2026
charts.basis: International commodity price index, with the 2014-2016 average equal to 100. These values are not dollar prices.
charts.sourceTitle: FAO Food Price Index monthly data
charts.note: The latest FAO dataset includes revisions to previously published monthly estimates, particularly for meat.

series.label: Dairy
series.definition: Monthly movement in international quotations for butter, cheese, skim milk powder, and whole milk powder.

series.label: Meat
series.definition: Monthly movement in international quotations for bovine, ovine, pig, and poultry meat.

charts.title: U.S. cattle supply
charts.description: July 1 inventory and annual calf crop, 2025 and 2026
charts.basis: USDA national estimates in millions of animals. Beef cows are a July 1 inventory; calf crop covers the calendar year.
charts.note: July cattle inventory reporting was not conducted in 2024. The chart begins with the resumed July 2025 release.

series.label: Beef cows
series.definition: Cows and heifers that have calved and are kept for beef production, estimated on July 1.

series.label: Calf crop
series.definition: Calves born during the calendar year, reported as USDA's annual national estimate.

series.label: Cattle on feed
series.definition: Cattle being fed a concentrated ration for slaughter in U.S. feedlots on the reporting date.
